A foil reel mounting device (10; 40) for supporting a reel (2) of stamping foil (3) in a supporting module (1). The device is fixed to the supporting module (1). A retaining element (12; 42) mounted on the support (11; 41) and arranged to move between a closed position, in which the retaining element (12; 42) retains the axle (7) of the reel (2) in the recess (16; 46), and an open position, in which the retaining element (12; 42) releases the axle (7) of the reel (2) from the recess (16; 46). The retaining element (12; 42) is biased towards the closed position. Also, a supporting module (1) has at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40) and a stamping machine (100) includes a supporting module (1) or at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40). A method for loading and unloading a reel (2) of stamping foil (3) with such at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40) is also disclosed.

outputs.L1: A foil reel mounting device (10; 40) supports a reel (2) of stamping foil (3) in a supporting module (1) and is fixed to the supporting module (1). The device comprises a support (11; 41) having a recess (16; 46) configured to receive an axle (7) of the reel (2), and a retaining element (12; 42) mounted on the support (11; 41). The retaining element (12; 42) is movable between a closed position, in which it retains the axle (7) in the recess (16; 46), and an open position, in which it releases the axle (7) from the recess (16; 46). The retaining element (12; 42) is biased toward the closed position. Also disclosed are a supporting module (1) comprising at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40), a stamping machine (100) comprising a supporting module (1) or at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40), and a method for loading and unloading a reel (2) of stamping foil (3) using such at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40).
outputs.L2: A mounting assembly (10; 40) is configured to hold a stamping-foil reel (2) carrying stamping foil (3) within a support module (1), to which the assembly is secured. The assembly comprises a bracket (11; 41) provided with a cavity (16; 46) for accommodating the reel axle (7). A locking member (12; 42) is attached to the bracket (11; 41) and is movable between two states: a locking state, where it keeps the axle (7) seated in the cavity (16; 46), and a release state, where the axle (7) can be removed from the cavity (16; 46). The locking member (12; 42) is urged toward its locking state. The disclosure further covers a support module (1) equipped with one or more mounting assemblies (10; 40), as well as a stamping machine (100) incorporating either such a support module (1) or at least one of the mounting assemblies (10; 40). It also describes a procedure for installing and removing a stamping-foil reel (2) using one or more of these mounting assemblies (10; 40).
outputs.L3:
A foil reel mounting device is designed to support a reel of stamping foil within a supporting module. The device includes a support having a recess configured to receive the axle of the foil reel. A movable retaining element cooperates with the support to secure the axle within the recess when the retaining element is in a closed position. When moved to an open position, the retaining element allows the axle—and therefore the reel—to be inserted into or removed from the support.

The retaining element is biased toward the closed position, helping to ensure that the reel remains securely mounted during operation. This biasing arrangement may also simplify reel installation by allowing the retaining element to return automatically to its secured position after the axle has been placed in the recess.

The disclosure further encompasses supporting modules incorporating the mounting device, as well as stamping machines equipped with one or more such modules. It also covers methods for loading and unloading stamping-foil reels, including opening the retaining element, positioning or removing the reel axle relative to the support recess, and allowing the retaining element to return to its closed position to secure the reel.
outputs.L4:
A foil reel mounting device for a stamping machine is designed to simplify the installation, retention, and removal of a reel axle. The device includes a support having a recessed receiving region in which the axle of the foil reel can be positioned. A movable retaining element is arranged adjacent to the recess and can be displaced between a closed position, in which the axle is captured within the support, and an open position, in which the axle can be inserted or removed.

The retaining element is biased toward the closed position by a spring or another resilient member. Once the axle has been placed in the recessed support, the retaining element automatically returns to its closed position and prevents the axle from being unintentionally lifted or displaced during operation. The spring force therefore provides reliable reel retention without requiring complicated locking procedures or separate fastening components.

For loading or unloading, an operator moves the retaining element against the spring bias to open the receiving region. This movement releases the axle and permits the foil reel to be removed or replaced in a straightforward manner. After the new reel axle has been introduced into the recess, releasing the retaining element allows it to return automatically to the securing position.

The arrangement combines dependable axle retention with convenient manual access. It reduces the effort required to change foil reels, minimizes the risk of incorrect locking, and supports efficient reel handling. The device is particularly suitable for foil-reel supporting modules and stamping machines in which reels must be replaced regularly while remaining securely mounted during operation.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a spring-biased mounting device that secures the axle of a stamping foil reel within a supporting module.
counterfactuals.output: A mounting device for securing an axle of a stamping foil reel within a supporting module is disclosed. The mounting device includes a body defining an axle-receiving seat, a retaining member movable between a release position and a securing position, and a spring arranged to bias the retaining member toward the securing position. Upon insertion of the axle into the seat, the retaining member is displaced against the spring bias and subsequently engages the axle to restrict withdrawal and maintain the reel in an operative position. The retaining member may be manually moved to the release position to permit removal or replacement of the reel. The spring-biased arrangement enables rapid, tool-free mounting while accommodating dimensional tolerances and reducing unintended axle displacement during operation of a stamping apparatus.

counterfactuals.output: A foil reel holder includes a body defining a recessed support configured to receive and rotatably support a reel of foil. A retaining element is movably coupled to the body between a closed position, in which the retaining element at least partially obstructs removal of the reel from the recessed support, and an open position permitting insertion or removal of the reel. A biasing member urges the retaining element toward the closed position such that the retaining element automatically retains the reel after installation.
